policy: Optional original-player quest adaptations inspired by manga cover-story structures. These are not retellings, do not assign actions to canon characters, and never alter manga-canon outcomes.

quest_chains.title: A Crew Without a Flag

stages.title: Find the Scattered
stages.setup: A storm scatters a small pirate crew and leaves its quartermaster stranded near a fishing village.
objectives: Locate two missing crew members
Recover a damaged logbook or learn its contents from witnesses
approaches: Ask dockworkers and pay for leads
Track the rival scavengers who reached the wreck first
stages.fail_forward: The crew is found later, but loses supplies or trust; the next stage remains available.

stages.title: Earn a New Berth
stages.setup: The survivors need repairs and a safe place to regroup, but the village fears attracting pirates.
objectives: Secure repairs or a replacement vessel
Resolve the village's concern without forcing allegiance
approaches: Negotiate protection with a local group
stages.fail_forward: A rough vessel is secured at a higher cost, and the village remains cautious.

stages.title: Choose the Flag
stages.setup: A rival offers the crew a shortcut if they abandon one of their own.
objectives: Decide whether to reunite, recruit, or part ways
Settle the rival's claim
approaches: Stand together and confront the rival
Use a decoy route to get everyone clear
stages.fail_forward: The crew escapes the immediate threat, but its final roster and reputation reflect the cost.

outcomes: A grateful independent crew becomes a recurring contact
A repaired ship and local trade contact are gained
The crew disperses peacefully, leaving future leads

quest_chains.title: A Second Chance at the Wharf

stages.title: The Wharf Incident
stages.setup: A former gang lookout is blamed when a delivery of seafood disappears.
objectives: Find the missing cargo
Determine whether the suspect is being framed
approaches: Inspect the route and tide marks
Offer to replace the cargo while investigating
stages.fail_forward: The cargo is not recovered, but a witness identifies the next lead.

stages.title: Prove Good Faith
stages.setup: The suspect wants to open a food stall but local merchants distrust their past.
objectives: Secure a stall or temporary permit
Complete a fair trade or community task
stages.fail_forward: A temporary stall opens with limited stock and reduced local trust.

stages.title: The First Opening Day
stages.setup: A sabotage attempt threatens the stall's first busy day.
objectives: Protect customers and supplies
Choose how to handle the saboteur
approaches: Protect the stall first and pursue evidence later
stages.fail_forward: The stall survives with damaged stock; its owner remembers whether the player protected people.

outcomes: A neutral food vendor and recovery contact
A low-cost supply source with cautious trust
A local rival relationship shaped by the player's choice

quest_chains.title: The Workshop After the Fall

stages.title: Scrap and Shelter
stages.setup: A displaced island official is turning salvaged machinery into a workshop while former retainers demand unpaid wages.
objectives: Assess the workshop's safety
Hear the workers' claims
approaches: Help workers establish an independent shop
stages.fail_forward: The workshop pauses operations, but the workers' claims and evidence remain available.

stages.title: A Market for Miracles
stages.setup: A merchant offers a lucrative contract that may rely on unsafe or misleading products.
objectives: Verify the contract
Choose whether to accept, renegotiate, or expose it
approaches: Warn the market and refuse the deal
stages.fail_forward: The contract is lost or delayed, but the player gains evidence and a reputation consequence.

stages.title: Who Owns the Future?
stages.setup: The workshop's success brings pressure to concentrate power or share ownership.
objectives: Resolve the ownership dispute
Decide who receives the workshop's future profits
approaches: Back the founder under transparent terms
stages.fail_forward: The workshop survives in a reduced form; its ownership and prices reflect the compromise.

outcomes: Worker-run workshop with modest local benefits
Independent entrepreneur contact with higher prices
Cooperative trade hub and improved settlement stability

quest_chains.title: Names on the Ledger

stages.title: The Old Network
stages.setup: Former members of a dissolved criminal outfit ask the player to locate a missing courier before a bounty hunter does.
objectives: Find the courier's last known route
Learn what information the courier carries
stages.fail_forward: The courier moves to a new hiding place; the player receives a reliable contact trail.

stages.title: An Inside Contact
stages.setup: The courier is held in a private lockup, and an insider offers help for a price.
objectives: Verify the insider's motives
Create a safe extraction plan
stages.fail_forward: The extraction fails cleanly, but the detainee is transferred and can be tracked.

stages.title: What to Do With the Names
stages.setup: The recovered ledger could expose victims, former criminals, and powerful clients.
objectives: Decide how to handle the ledger
Protect people named in it
approaches: Redact identities and expose the scheme
stages.fail_forward: The ledger is partly compromised; some names leak and the player must help those affected.

outcomes: Victim protection network and improved trust
Public scandal with a local faction response
Destroyed ledger but a surviving witness network

quest_chains.title: The Price of a Safe Harbor

stages.title: The Medical Bill
stages.setup: A fugitive crew seeks medicine for an injured crewmate but cannot safely enter a public clinic.
objectives: Find a legitimate treatment route
Keep the clinic out of the crew's dispute
stages.fail_forward: Treatment is delayed but the patient stabilizes; the crew's debt increases.

stages.title: A Town Under Pressure
stages.setup: Pursuers threaten a town that sheltered the fugitives.
objectives: Identify the pursuers' leverage
Protect residents without forcing them to take sides
stages.fail_forward: The town suffers limited disruption, but residents retain a route to safety.

stages.title: Leave or Stay
stages.setup: The crew can disappear, repay the town, or remain to help rebuild.
objectives: Choose the crew's next step
Settle the outstanding debt or obligation
approaches: Arrange a quiet departure and repayment
Turn over evidence and seek a lawful settlement
stages.fail_forward: The crew leaves under pressure; the town's attitude records whether the player helped.

outcomes: A town that offers shelter to trustworthy crews
A fugitive contact with a complicated debt

quest_chains.title: Seven Sails, Seven Agendas

stages.title: Captains at Anchor
stages.setup: Several independent captains arrive at the same port, each claiming a different version of a shared agreement.
objectives: Hear each captain's terms
Identify the actual point of conflict
approaches: Review the original pact and witnesses
stages.fail_forward: The captains refuse a joint meeting, but individual negotiations remain possible.

stages.title: The Shared Problem
stages.setup: A blockade threatens all crews, but their preferred responses differ.
objectives: Find a response that does not erase each crew's independence
Secure food and safe passage
approaches: Create a diversion to open a civilian route
stages.fail_forward: Only part of the fleet gets through; the remaining captains remember who was helped.

stages.title: No One Owns the Flag
stages.setup: A proposed alliance risks turning independent crews into subordinates.
objectives: Set the terms of future cooperation
Decide whether the pact is temporary or lasting
approaches: Keep the crews independent but share signals
Decline the alliance and settle immediate obligations
stages.fail_forward: The pact dissolves without a battle; individual crew relationships persist.

outcomes: Several separate crew contacts with distinct loyalties
